name: Uncover: Ebook Reader
subtitle: Read CBZ, CBR, PDF, and EPUB. Comics, manga, novels — all in one app.
description:
Uncover: The All-in-One eBook & Comic Reader
Read CBZ, CBR, PDF, and EPUB. Enjoy Comics, Manga, Manhwa, Doujins, and More.

Ready to transform the way you read?
Uncover is your ultimate ebook reader and comic reader for every format—CBZ, CBR, PDF, and EPUB. Seamlessly enjoy your favorite manga, manhwa, doujins, graphic novels, and documents in one user-friendly app.

Key Features

- Multiple Format Support
Effortlessly open CBZ, CBR, PDF, and EPUB files. Dive into novels, comics, manga, or any document without switching apps.

- Privacy & Discreet Reading
Protect your reading library with a Pin Lock or Face ID. Hide the screen when switching apps, ensuring total privacy for personal files or sensitive documents.

- Instant Bookmarks
Save memorable moments with easy bookmarking. Build a library of favorite pages and share them with friends to spread the joy of reading.

- Favorites Library
Keep your most-loved books, manga, and comics at your fingertips. Add any file to Favorites for quick access whenever inspiration strikes.

- Smart Organization
Organize your entire ebook and comic collection in one place. Sort by title or customize folders with emojis and colors to create a visually appealing library.

- Feedback & Support
We value your input! Share ideas or suggestions via email to help us improve Uncover. Together, let's craft the best ebook reader experience.

- Unlock Premium Features
Enjoy a 3-day FREE trial of Uncover Premium. Access exclusive tools to enhance your reading—perfect for devoted manga fans or serious ebook enthusiasts.

- Flexible Subscription
If you choose to subscribe, payments are charged to your Apple account. Manage auto-renewal settings in the App Store. Get Lifetime Purchases without any renewals for uninterrupted reading bliss.

Why Choose Uncover?
Versatile: Supports all major file formats—CBR, CBZ, PDF, EPUB—so you can enjoy novels, comics, manga, and more.
Secure & Private: Lock your content with Face ID or PIN.
Simple & Stylish: Customize folders with emojis, colors, and easy sorting options.
Reader-Focused: Bookmarks, Favorites, and a discreet reading mode for ultimate convenience.
Uncover the joy of reading today—where comic lovers, manga enthusiasts, and ebook readers unite in a single, powerful app.
